originsx.creator.desc.attribute: Adjusts one of your attributes while the race is active.
originsx.creator.desc.conditional: Applies a strength or weakness only while a condition is met.
originsx.creator.desc.damage_immunity: Grants complete immunity to a specific type of damage (fire, fall, drowning, etc.).
originsx.creator.desc.earthquake: AoE slam that damages, knocks up and slows nearby enemies. Deals self-damage.
originsx.creator.desc.effect_removal: Makes you immune to a status effect.
originsx.creator.desc.grant_item: Gives the player a specified vanilla item when they select this race.
originsx.creator.desc.on_eat: On eating food: heals and grants resource.
originsx.creator.desc.on_interact: Configurable right-click trigger. Choose what activates it (any click, block, entity, item in hand, specific block/entity) and what happens (effect, heal, damage, heal/damage target, summon, teleport).
originsx.creator.desc.on_kill: On killing a mob: heals, grants resource and a short Strength boost.
originsx.creator.desc.reach: Passively modifies your interaction range with blocks and entities. Multiplier 1.0 = normal, < 1 = short arms, > 1 = long arms.
originsx.creator.desc.resource: Grants the race a resource pool (mana/stamina); active powers with a cost spend it.
originsx.creator.desc.shadow_step: Teleports behind the nearest entity, deals backstab damage and applies Weakness.
originsx.creator.desc.size_control: Changes your character size on key press. Permanent mode is a toggle; timed mode applies for a set duration.
originsx.creator.desc.status_effect: Applies a status effect for the chosen duration.
originsx.creator.desc.summon: Active power: press the key to spawn creatures near you.
originsx.creator.desc.teleport_strike: Teleports to the nearest entity you look at, deals damage and applies Nausea.
originsx.creator.hint.attribute_ops: add_value: base + n (health, armor, reach, etc.) | multiply_base: base × (1+n%) (movement_speed, fly_speed, gravity) | multiply_total: final × (1+n%) (rare use)
originsx.creator.hint.movement_speed: Base value is 0.1. +0.1 ADD_VALUE = +100% speed. Use multiply_base for percentage boosts.

originsx.creator.param.infinite_hint: When on, you don't need to set duration or interval.
originsx.creator.param.resource_gain.hin: How much of the race's resource pool (mana/stamina) a kill or a meal restores. Needs a 'Resource pool' power in the race, otherwise it does nothing.

originsx.guide.conditions.intro: Conditions restrict conditional powers — 50 types available, including item checks (held_item, wearing_item), moon phases, nearby creatures, scoreboard and composites (all_of / any_of / not). Parameters depend on the chosen condition.
originsx.guide.conditions.title: Conditions
originsx.guide.fields.datapack: Datapack name — the folder that stores the race. Latin letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
originsx.guide.fields.description: Description — optional text describing the race. Supports minecraft translation keys.
originsx.guide.fields.difficulty: Difficulty — scale from -5 (very strong) to +5 (very weak), pick with buttons or type a number. The gauge below shows the value visually. Affects the race classification.
originsx.guide.fields.icon: Icon item — a minecraft item shown in the race list, e.g. minecraft:feather.
originsx.guide.fields.id: ID — a unique resource location like mypack:my_race. Used to identify the race. If empty, one is generated from the name.
originsx.guide.fields.name: Name — the display name shown in the race list. Up to 40 characters.
originsx.guide.fields.scale: Character scale — the size of your character. Between 0.25 and 4.0; 1.0 is normal.
originsx.guide.fields.title: Race fields
originsx.guide.powers.active: Active powers are triggered by pressing a key. They get a slot from 0 to 8; each slot has its own keybind.
originsx.guide.powers.conditional: Conditional powers only apply while a condition is met, e.g. in water or at night.
originsx.guide.powers.difficulty: Power difficulty feeds the balance meter above the power list: negative = stronger, positive = weaker. Strong power types (flight, summon, immunity) are counted automatically.
originsx.guide.powers.intro: Powers are the abilities a race grants. Each power has a type, a difficulty and optionally parameters.
originsx.guide.powers.passive: Passive powers work constantly — buffs are shown green, debuffs red.
originsx.guide.powers.title: Powers
originsx.guide.save.copy: Copy JSON — copies the race file to the clipboard so you can place it manually or share it.
originsx.guide.save.datapack: Save to datapack — writes the race into data/<datapack>/raceapi/races/*.json in the current world. Works in singleplayer.
originsx.guide.save.edit: Races saved in your world show an Edit button in the detail panel. Deleting removes the file and reloads.
originsx.guide.save.title: Saving & editing
originsx.guide.start.hint: Your race appears instantly in the list on the left and can be selected right away.
originsx.guide.start.step1: Open the Create Race tab and give your race a name (up to 40 characters).
originsx.guide.start.step2: Optionally set a datapack name (latin letters) and an ID like mypack:my_race. If left empty, they are generated for you.
originsx.guide.start.step3: Pick an icon item and, if you want, tune the character scale.
originsx.guide.start.step4: Add powers with the form below. Active powers are triggered by a key; passive ones work on their own.
originsx.guide.start.step5: Press Save to datapack to write the race into the current world, or Copy JSON to share it.
originsx.guide.start.title: Getting started
originsx.guide.title: Race Creator Guide
originsx.guide.types.intro: Every power type has its own set of parameters. Active powers are marked in gold. On interact: a configurable right-click trigger with 7 modes and 7 actions.
originsx.guide.types.title: Power types
originsx.hud.settings.hint: Position = distance from the chosen anchor edge in pixels (positive values move inward). Texture path: a PNG file - absolute, relative to the game folder, or put it into config/originsx/. Leave empty for the built-in style. Changes apply on Save.
